title: MSP Render Job Manifest
description: A single deterministic render job: which CAD file, which camera, which lighting, which background. Everything the pipeline needs is in here - there is no hidden state.

job_id.description: Unique job name. Also the default output folder name.

_description.description: Free-text note for humans. Ignored by the pipeline.

file_path.description: Absolute path, or a path relative to the project root, to a .blend / .glb / .gltf / .obj file.

preset.description: A P1-P8 studio preset, CUSTOM to use the angles below, or USE_SCENE_CAMERA / PRESERVE_EXISTING to keep the camera already in the .blend.

scene_camera_name.description: Name of a camera object inside the .blend to render through. Easier than tuning angles for tight detail shots.

distance_multiplier.description: Camera distance as a multiple of the model's bounding radius. Larger = machine sits smaller in frame.

target_offset.description: [x, y, z] aim point. x and y are multiples of the bounding radius; z is a fraction of the model's centre height.

smooth_hardware.description: Smooth-shade and subdivide latches/handles/hinges. Skipped automatically on meshes carrying CAD custom split normals.

hide_misplaced_isolators.description: Hide vibration isolator meshes that sit outside the skid.

preset.description: msp_standard_yellow, united_rentals_blue, custom, or preserve_existing to keep the materials already in the .blend.
Which analytic light rig to build. preserve_existing keeps the lights already in the .blend.

intensity_multiplier.description: Scales the analytic rig only. Does NOT scale hdri_strength - the two are balanced against each other independently.

analytic_lights.description: Set false for pure image-based lighting: the HDRI is then the only light source.

key_enabled.description: Batch 3f experimental diagnostic only: set false to omit Key_Softbox from the studio_dark/studio_white analytic rig while leaving Fill_Softbox and Rim_Light unchanged. No effect when analytic_lights is false; false is not an accepted production look.

fill_enabled.description: Batch 3g experimental diagnostic only: set false to omit Fill_Softbox from the studio_dark/studio_white analytic rig while leaving Key_Softbox and Rim_Light unchanged. No effect when analytic_lights is false; false is not an accepted production look.

rim_enabled.description: Batch 3g experimental diagnostic only: set false to omit Rim_Light from the studio_dark/studio_white analytic rig while leaving Key_Softbox and Fill_Softbox unchanged. No effect when analytic_lights is false; false is not an accepted production look.

rim_profile.description: Batch 3h look selector for the studio_dark/studio_white analytic rig, opt-in and absent by default. pool_v1 is the shipped Rim_Light rig exactly (no attribute is written) and is what an absent value selects; pool_soft diffuses the same SPOT in the same place at the same power (spot_blend 0.35, shadow_soft_size 0.35*radius). No effect in any other lighting branch and no effect when analytic_lights is false. pool_soft is the owner-accepted rig look of record since 2026-09-24 (jobs/rl300_05_studio-floor.json carries it); an absent value still selects pool_v1.

shadow_catcher.description: Add an invisible ground plane that receives shadows. Leave false when compositing, since composite_worker synthesizes the contact shadow.

hdri_path.description: Image used as the world environment texture. Point this at the same file as compositing.background_plate so the machine is lit by the scene it will be dropped into. Omit or null to use the preset's procedural sky.

enabled.description: Add a real rendered neutral studio floor after the ground-hide pass. Requires output.film_transparent=false, unit product scale and zero product offset; suppresses the shadow catcher in every lighting branch. The product cutout then comes from a second floor-hidden render (beauty-matte.png / mask.png).

material_polish.description: Fixes the surface response of raw CAD materials without changing a single authored colour. glTF imports every untextured CAD colour at roughness 1.0 / metallic 0, which Cycles renders as chalk. Leave disabled for a .blend whose materials have already been art-directed - it only ever touches materials still at importer defaults.

dark_threshold.description: Relative luminance below which a colour is treated as a dark machined/anodised part rather than a light alloy one.

radius_m.description: Shader-only edge rounding. CAD edges are mathematically sharp and read as fake; a 0.4 mm bevel catches a highlight the way real sheet metal does, at zero geometry cost.

film_transparent.description: Render on transparent film so the product can be composited onto a plate. Leave the default true for cut-outs; a rendered studio floor (lighting.floor.enabled) requires false, because the floor must be baked into the beauty pass.

alpha_mask.description: Also write mask.png, the alpha matte split out of the beauty pass.

enabled.description: False means the transparent render IS the deliverable; `run` stops after rendering.

product_scale.description: Prefer changing camera.distance_multiplier instead - that resizes the machine without resampling the render.

product_offset_pct.description: [dx, dy] as a fraction of canvas size, so placement tuned on a fast low-res preview lands identically on the full-res final.
